intersection.title: Video 1 - cars at an intersection (camera held still)
intersection.about: Filmed by me on an iPhone, hand-held and kept as still as I could, looking across a road intersection. Cars cross in both directions at different distances.
intersection.source: My own recording, IMG_1893.MOV (0 s to 30 s of 52.7 s), 1920x1080 30 fps HEVC HDR, tone-mapped to SDR, scaled to 960x540 and re-encoded to H.264

pan.title: Video 2 - panning across the road
pan.about: Filmed by me on an iPhone, hand-held. The first seconds are held still while cars pass; then I turn slowly left and right across the scene, so the whole picture moves.
pan.source: My own recording, IMG_1895.MOV (5 s to 35 s of 60.8 s), 1920x1080 30 fps HEVC HDR, tone-mapped to SDR, scaled to 960x540 and re-encoded to H.264
